xSUSHI is a staking token of the SushiSwap protocol. xSUSHI is issued to users who stake SUSHI tokens. xSUSHI holders receive a share of the trading fees collected by SushiSwap.

Ankr is a Web3 infrastructure provider that operates blockchain nodes across multiple public networks. Ankr offers staking services that include liquid staking tokens. Ankr provides remote procedure call access to blockchain networks for developers.

Orca is a decentralized exchange built on the Solana blockchain. Orca uses an automated market maker design. Orca offers concentrated liquidity pools called Whirlpools.
